description: This Java class defines a singleton validator that checks if a CharSequence value is a valid ThingId object, throwing a DittoHeaderInvalidException if validation fails.

classes.name: DittoMessageThingIdValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton class that validates whether a given CharSequence is a valid ThingId; throws exception on invalid value.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the validator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates that the provided CharSequence can be converted into a ThingId; throws DittoHeaderInvalidException if invalid.
